name: Midnight Sun Fire Celebration at Patscherkofel
beschreibung: Celebrate the Summer Solstice at Patscherkofel above Innsbruck. A grand **Sonnwendfeuer** (Midnight Sun fire), live music, and local delicacies mark the longest day of the year. The panoramic view from 2,000 meters over the glowing mountain landscape at dusk is unforgettable.
kurzbeschreibung: Sonnwendfeuer and festivities at Patscherkofel – the longest day of the year with breathtaking views over Innsbruck.
